messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The root cause of INC-2025-023 was a reindex job that failed silently on a full disk. [valid 2025-10-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- The root cause of INC-2025-011 was an index missing after the schema migration. [valid 2025-05-30 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-011]
- The indexer served stale results for two days on 2025-10-03 during incident INC-2025-023. [valid 2025-10-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- Reindex jobs will page on failure, because a silent reindex failure left stale results for two days in INC-2025-023. [decision; valid 2025-10-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- Boreal noticed the ledger service's memory growth and pinged the owners on 2025-02-21. [valid 2025-02-21 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-21-2]
- As of the 2025-12-19 handover, the product catalog's dashboards and alerts are being repointed. [valid 2025-12-19 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-19-catalog]
- As of 2025-12-18, the Boreal team adopted a weekly dependency update day. [decision; valid 2025-12-18 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-12-18]
- At the Boreal standup on 2025-11-03, it was decided that the webhook dispatcher will sign payloads with rotating keys. [decision; valid 2025-11-03 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-11-03]
- The root cause of INC-2025-017 was an expired intermediate certificate. [valid 2025-08-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]
- The cause of INC-2026-003 was a retry loop that ignored idempotency keys. [valid 2026-02-26 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- On 2025-12-01, the Boreal team observed that the job scheduler's cold start time tripled following the runtime upgrade, and since it was not their service, they flagged it. [valid 2025-12-01 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-12-01-2]
- The Boreal team noticed on 2025-05-07 that the authentication gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump and pinged the owners. [valid 2025-05-07 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-05-07-2]
- The root cause of INC-2026-009 was two leaders elected during a network partition. [valid 2026-05-19 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- As of 2025-04-22, the search indexer is pinned to OpenSearch 2.11 until the full reindex completes. [constraint; valid 2025-04-22 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-22]
- During INC-2026-003, the webhook dispatcher delivered some events twice on 2026-02-20. [valid 2026-02-26 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- The Boreal team observed on 2025-12-01 that the billing API's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump. [valid 2025-12-01 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-12-01]
- The root cause of INC-2025-004 was a consumer offset stuck after a broker restart. [valid 2025-02-05 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-004]
- Follow-up decision from the INC-2026-003 review: the webhook dispatcher will require an idempotency key on every delivery, because duplicate deliveries in INC-2026-003 came from retries without one. [decision; valid 2026-02-26 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- The notifier is owned by the Dune team as of 2025-06-11, when ownership passed from the Boreal team. [decision; valid 2025-06-27 to now; recorded by handover/2025-06-27-notifier-correction]
    earlier: The notifier is owned by Cinder as of 2025-06-11, when ownership passed from the Boreal team. [decision; valid 2025-06-11 to 2025-06-27; recorded by handover/2025-06-11-notifier]
    earlier: The Boreal team owns the notifier. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-06-11; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09-2]
- The Boreal team observed on 2025-11-03 that the notification service's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift. [valid 2025-11-03 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-11-03-2]
